h1: Bed Bug Treatment in NYC — Complete Elimination
heroParagraph: Bed bugs are one of the most stressful pest problems a New Yorker can face — and one of the most misunderstood. DIY products don't work. Foggers don't work. Even many professional treatments fail without the right approach. Whole-room heat treatment is the gold standard: it raises the temperature above 120°F throughout the entire space, killing bed bugs and their eggs in every hiding spot — no chemicals, no residue, no exceptions.
bodyParagraphs: Bed bugs spread through luggage brought home from travel, used furniture purchased or found on the street, shared laundry facilities in apartment buildings, and through gaps in walls and floors between units. They feed exclusively on blood â human blood, ideally â and can survive up to 18 months without a meal. That means an 'empty' apartment you just moved into might not be as empty as you think.

The biology makes them exceptionally hard to eliminate. Bed bug eggs are resistant to most chemical treatments. Bed bugs in later life stages can detect repellent chemicals and avoid treated areas. This is why so many infestations survive amateur treatment attempts and grow worse. Heat is the only treatment that kills all life stages â including eggs â throughout the entire room simultaneously.

faqs.q: How do I know if I have bed bugs and not something else?
faqs.a: The clearest signs are the physical evidence: bloodstains on sheets, dark fecal spots on the mattress, and shed skins in mattress seams. Bites alone are unreliable â many people don't react to bed bug bites. Call us and we will give you a free phone assessment within minutes.

faqs.q: Do I have to throw away my mattress?
faqs.a: No. Heat treatment kills bed bugs and their eggs inside mattresses, box springs, and furniture without any need to discard them. Throwing away your mattress without proper treatment is usually counterproductive â bed bugs spread to walls and furniture and simply reinfest the new mattress.

faqs.q: How long does heat treatment take?
faqs.a: A typical apartment heat treatment takes 6â8 hours. During that time, you'll need to vacate the space along with any pets, plants, and heat-sensitive items (candles, aerosols, certain electronics). We'll provide a complete preparation list when you book.

faqs.q: Can bed bugs come back after heat treatment?
faqs.a: Heat treatment eliminates every bed bug and egg present in the treated space on the day of treatment. However, bed bugs can reinfest from adjacent units in multi-unit buildings. Our covers retreatment if bed bugs return within the period.
